sources.title: Ministral 8B: VRAM, GGUF sizes and how to run it | LightPhon
sources.snippet: Ministral 8B is a 8B-parameter model from Mistral AI with a 128,000-token context window. The Q4_K_M GGUF build is about 4.5 GB and needs roughly 5.7 GB of VRAM to run at a short context — that fits a RTX 3060 12GB / RTX 4070. At Q8_0 it needs about 9.6 GB, and unquantized F16 about 17.6 GB.
